'''Docking pad 28''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] docking facility located on [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. It was constructed on piles, above a marsh.

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the ''[[Stinger]]'', owned by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], docked at docking pad 28 while [[Guri]] killed the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]].
